context: A dad and his young son watch a baseball game on TV
purpose: Teach: スコア/トレード/突破/ランク/予選/対抗/先行/偉大

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おっ、見ろよ、九回でついに二点先行したぞ。
lines.en: Oh, look, we finally took a two-run lead in the ninth.
lines.style: Excited dad pointing at TV with rising voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、このバッターってすごい選手なの?
lines.en: Dad, is this batter a great player?
lines.style: Curious child looking up with wide eyes

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、予選から大活躍で、チームを突破に導いた偉大な選手だよ。
lines.en: Yeah, he was amazing from the qualifiers and led the team through the breakthrough — a truly great player.
lines.style: Proud dad explaining with warm admiring tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でもさ、去年トレードで来たばっかりって聞いたよ。
lines.en: But I heard he just came over in a trade last year.
lines.style: Sharp kid showing off recent knowledge proudly

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: よく知ってるな。あのトレードでチームのランクが一気に上がったんだ。
lines.en: You know your stuff. That trade boosted the team's rank big time.
lines.style: Impressed dad ruffling son's hair affectionately

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今日の相手チームも強そうだけど、対抗できるかな?
lines.en: Today's opponents look strong too — can we hold our own?
lines.style: Nervous child clutching cushion during tense moment

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: スコアは二点リードだから大丈夫、このまま逃げ切ろう。
lines.en: The score's a two-run lead, so we'll be fine — let's hang on.
lines.style: Confident dad reassuring with a steady calm voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった!僕もいつかあんなすごい選手になりたいな。
lines.en: Yay! Someday I want to become an amazing player like him.
lines.style: Hopeful child with bright shining eager eyes
